description: This file provides utility functions for converting data into CSV format, triggering CSV downloads in browsers, and combining these actions for ease of use. It includes functions to generate CSV strings from object arrays, download CSV files with UTF-8 BOM support, and a convenience method to export data directly as a downloadable CSV.
external_files: document (DOM) for creating and removing HTML elements

methods.name: toCsv(rows, { headers, delimiter = ",", includeHeader = true, replacer } = {})
methods.description: Converts an array of objects into a CSV string, with options for headers, delimiter, header inclusion, and custom value replacer.

methods.name: downloadCsv(csv, filename = "export.csv")
methods.description: Creates a Blob from CSV string with UTF-8 BOM, triggers a browser download for the CSV file.

methods.name: exportCsv(rows, { filename = "export.csv", ...opts } = {})
methods.description: Combines `toCsv` and `downloadCsv` functions to generate and immediately download a CSV from data.

ctags.name: toCsv
ctags.pattern: /^export function toCsv(rows, { headers, delimiter = ",", includeHeader = true, replacer } = {}) {$/
